who_may_file.conditions: Recorded property owner (not an LLC) who owns and lives in the single-family home or duplex side as their primary residence, not intended for sale, lease, or rent; work done by homeowner or immediate family member only
who_may_file.quote: Homeowners may pull permits for their own primary home if the: * property is not and will not be for sale, lease or rent. * work will be done by the homeowner or an immediate family member.

requirements.item: Submit online Request for Single Family Residential Service in PowerPartner with connected load (kW), load schedule, and site plans
requirements.quote: The form should include: connected load in kilowatts (kW), load schedule, site plans, landscaping plans, and other critical details so the service and design project manager can complete their review.

requirements.item: Obtain city/county building and electrical permits before PGE completes service construction and meter installation
requirements.quote: You will need to get building and electrical permits from the city or county, as well as easements and tree-trimming permits if required.

requirements.item: PGE inspects all services, trenches, and conduits before completing service construction and installing the meter
requirements.quote: We inspect all services, trenches and conduits, and then complete construction of electrical service and install the meter.

open_questions: No dedicated City of Portland single-family residential electrical submittal checklist was found for standalone Level 2 EV chargers, standby/portable generators, or residential battery energy storage systems (ESS) on portland.gov.

The 'Checklist and Submittal Requirements for Prescriptive Solar installations' and 'Required solar permit application documents and plans' pages referenced on https://www.portland.gov/ppd/solar-permit-app-guide and https://www.portland.gov/ppd/residential-permitting/structural-engineering/one-and-two-family-residential-structures were not indexed to verify electrical one-line diagram or battery storage specifics.

Portland is served by both Portland General Electric (PGE) and Pacific Power depending on neighborhood; PGE requirements are cited above as the primary utility, while Pacific Power requirements were not separately queried.
No City of Portland-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method, or EV charger service load factor was found on portland.gov.

checklist.title: Checklist and Submittal Requirements for Prescriptive Solar installations

requirements.item: Solar Permit Request submitted online via DevHub with scaled PDF plan set (max 100MB; no sketches)
requirements.quote: Upload a PDF of your plan set (file size cannot exceed 100MB) and any other required documents for your permit project.

requirements.item: Structural Design Criteria on sheet 1 stamped by an Oregon Registered Design Professional (min 20 psf snow, 98 mph wind, dead load)
requirements.quote: The structural design criteria shall be listed on the first page of the drawings which shall be stamped by a Registered Design Professional, registered in Oregon.

requirements.item: Solar Worksheet for Prescriptive Path Eligibility (for Prescriptive Path projects)
requirements.quote: Note: Only required for the Prescriptive Path. Please use the Solar Worksheet for guidance on Prescriptive Path Eligibility questions and requirements.

requirements.item: Email address and phone number for the property owner and designer or technical lead
requirements.quote: An email address and phone number for the property owner and the designer or technical lead on your project must be submitted with the permit application.

sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: Adobe Acrobat (.pdf) format uploaded via DevHub, max 100MB; all plans drawn to scale (no sketches)
sheet_requirements.signature_or_stamp: Structural drawings and design criteria stamped/signed by an Oregon Registered Design Professional
sheet_requirements.quote: All plans must be drawn to scale. Not allowed: No sketches.

local_rules.rule: Solar permit revisions must be submitted as a Building Permit Request in DevHub, not a Solar Permit Request
local_rules.quote: Although you are applying to revise a solar permit application, DO NOT select “Solar Permit Request.” Select “Building Permit Request”
